import numpy as np


def attention_forward(Q, K, V):
    """Q, K, V are (T, d). Return (out, cache)."""
    d = Q.shape[1]
    scale = 1.0 / np.sqrt(d)
    S = (Q @ K.T) * scale          # (T, T)
    S_max = S.max(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    S_shift = S - S_max
    E = np.exp(S_shift)
    P = E / E.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)   # (T, T), row-wise softmax
    out = P @ V                    # (T, d)
    cache = (Q, K, V, P, scale)
    return out, cache


def attention_backward(dout, cache):
    """dout is (T, d). Return (dQ, dK, dV), each shaped like Q, K, V."""
    Q, K, V, P, scale = cache
    T = P.shape[0]

    # out = P @ V
    dP = dout @ V.T                # (T, T)
    dV = P.T @ dout                # (T, d)

    # softmax backward: for each row p, dS = P * (dP - sum(dP * P, axis=1))
    dS = P * (dP - np.sum(dP * P, axis=1, keepdims=True))   # (T, T)

    # S = scale * Q @ K.T
    dQ = (dS @ K) * scale          # (T, d)
    dK = (dS.T @ Q) * scale        # (T, d)

    return dQ, dK, dV
